items.title: Call for Grace Tame to be stripped of AOTY title over intifada chant
items.description: Grace Tame accused Australia of being "a so called democracy" that punishes peaceful protesters, before chanting "from Gadigal to Gaza, globalise the intifada!"

items.title: Live: Liberal moderates propose petition for Taylor to prove support for spill
items.description: Liberal Party moderates want to force Angus Taylor and his supporters to present a petition to prove he has the numbers if he wants to trigger a spill of Sussan Ley's leadership. Follow live.

items.title: 'We were aware': Aviation authority knew of issues at school before fatal crash
items.description: When a young pilot crashed his aircraft he and his two passengers died but there are questions as to why he was even flying after failing two exams.

items.title: Ghislaine Maxwell helped Jeffrey Epstein hide behind a veil of wealth
items.description: Powerful socialite Ghislaine Maxwell was able to exploit her connections to recruit, groom, and abuse dozens of young girls. Now, she faces a fresh interrogation over her role in Jeffrey Epstein's abuse.

items.title: 'He was pleased': Christchurch terrorist's former lawyer addresses court
items.description: A former lawyer for the Australian who murdered 51 people at two New Zealand mosques in 2019 tells a court the shooter "never wanted to defend the terrorism charge".

items.title: Harmful drinking water, $2.50-an-hour pay: What's happening with Carnival?
items.description: A major cruise ship has been investigated by the maritime safety regulator for claims around poor working conditions. A spokesperson for The Carnival Cruise Line says it has "nothing to hide" and welcomes AMSA's oversight.

items.title: Bondi terrorist father was 'more extremist' than son, former spy says
items.description: Bondi Beach terrorist Sajid Akram voiced support for the Islamic State group (IS) in 2019 and expressed admiration for a leading Al Qaeda propagandist, according to accounts from two men who moved in the same extremist circles.

items.title: Police foil 'serious, imminent' risk of planned Perth child abduction
items.description: A Perth man who planned to abduct and abuse a child, having scoped out schools and childcare centres and researched restraint methods, is jailed for seven years. Warning: This story contains details that some readers may find distressing.

items.title: Chappell Roan splits with Wasserman agency amid Maxwell email controversy
items.description: Pop star Chappell Roan says she is no longer represented by the talent agency led by Los Angeles 2028 Olympics chief Casey Wasserman, who has faced criticism for flirtatious email exchanges with convicted sex trafficker Ghislaine Maxwell more than 20 years ago.

items.title: Beyond cutting migration, what does One Nation believe in?
items.description: One Nation questions if man-made climate change is real, wants to wind back access to abortion care and plans to pay the HECS debts of doctors working in the regions.

items.title: At school, I was my brother's protector. But I needed more support
items.description: I was my brother's protector at school, but the education system could have done more to support us both.

items.title: Man charged after police allegedly find 125,000 child abuse files
items.description: A man appears in court after police officers seize a mobile and laptop with allegedly more than 125,000 files of child abuse material.

items.title: Live: ASX closes lower as CSL boss steps aside
items.description: The ASX 200 closed slightly lower, as the CSL chief executive steps aside ahead of tomorrow's half-year results. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Commonwealth asks to meet Roblox after child grooming reports. Here's what we know
items.description: Roblox has been called to an urgent meeting with the federal government in the wake of reports that children are being groomed by predators and exposed to sexually explicit material on the popular online gaming platform.

items.title: Salmon giant confirms antibiotic use in hatchery on River Derwent
items.description: There are calls for the public to be made aware of antibiotic use in Tasmania's freshwater hatcheries after Huon Aquaculture recently used oxytetracycline to treat diseased salmon without informing downstream users.

items.title: Winter Olympics 2026 quick guide: What to watch
items.description: Find out what's on at the Winter Olympics in Milan.

items.title: Jon Kudelka's take on Rudd v Gillard one of his best, says Insiders host
items.description: Hailed as an artist who "knew the power of comedy in holding truth to power", Jon Kudelka once described himself as "like a monkey with an automatic rifle".

items.title: These drugs are not going down to $25 under PBS script price changes
items.description: Painkillers, HRT therapies and incontinence medicines are among the drugs that will not benefit from the new maximum $25 script price.

items.title: Australians' super savings exposed as clouds gather over tech boom
items.description: Amongst tech investors the penny has finally dropped about just what the future may hold, and many are backing off or at least rethinking their strategy.

items.title: Government plans investment scheme crackdown after major funds collapse
items.description: The federal government plans a crackdown on managed investment schemes following the collapses of Shield Master Fund and First Guardian.

items.title: Quick hits: Emotional helmets and hakas as Bradbury clips Paul
items.description: Steven Bradbury hits Jake Paul with a drive-by as he celebrates Jutta Leerdam's Olympic gold, while a Sydney-born Kiwi receives a special celebration. Here are the quick hits from the Winter Olympics.

items.title: Queensland MP Nigel Dalton crosses floor during vote on abortion debate
items.description: First-term Liberal National Party MP Nigel Dalton votes to overturn a ban on debating abortion — in defiance of his party.

items.title: Mental health clinicians to flag 'high-risk' patients in gun licence crackdown
items.description: A raft of new gun laws in response to the Wieambilla shooting falls short of mandatory mental health checks for gun licence applicants.

items.title: International condemnation of new Israeli settlement measures in West Bank grows
items.description: The United Nations says it is "gravely concerned" over Israeli plans to expand control over the occupied West Bank.

items.title: Man spared jail over 'abhorrent' social media posts threatening politicians
items.description: A Sydney man who made "abhorrent" social media posts that promoted sexual violence and threatened the prime minister has been spared time in custody.
